record_title: Exact amplitude geometry obstructs Neimark-Sacker tori in the Hopf-Langford type system
provenance: Exact polar-amplitude analysis of the Hopf-Langford type system studied in arXiv:2609.18010v1, with comparison to prior Hopf-Langford integrability results.
limitations: The source-specific obstruction concerns smooth local tori in s>0 surrounding the circular orbit and transverse to the nonzero angular flow. It does not treat symmetry-breaking generalized systems, invariant sets touching the rotation axis, or beta=0. The dimensional reduction and first-integral mechanism are prior literature, not novelty claims. The source is a recent arXiv v1 and may later be revised.
